start.description: My mom got really sick and I need to move back home to Miami to take care of her. My lease here in Gainesville runs until July 31, 2027 and rent is $1,050 a month. I want to move out around December 15, 2026. When I signed the lease I also signed a paper saying I'd pay two months' rent if I leave early. I haven't told my landlord yet. I'm not in the military. It has nothing to do with repairs. The paper says the amount is $2,100.
